title: Channels Are Not UI Elements
description:
flow: No channel should be a ui element. Parametric input is passed over e.g. sliders. e.g. codemo vector component is showing steppers that it shouldnt.

Remove InputStepper (and channel param overlays) so components like math.vector expose only ports; numbers come from Slider sources.
summary: Channels are ports only — parametric input comes from sources like sliders, not inline channel editors or an InputStepper source. Removed InputStepper (Widget/NodeChrome/DagNodeKind/catalogue), channel param overlays on unconnected primitive ports (the bug on codemo math.vector x/y/z), and stepper overlays/APIs. Regenerated flow-dag manifest without stepper. Vector remains a computation component (math.vector) with ports; wire sliders into x/y/z.
